notes:
• Live Cameras rebuilt to feel like the MOBOTIX control center, with MXG Scout's ribbon. The top is a ribbon band grouped into Network (Scan Network, login) and Camera (Snapshot, Full Screen); the left is a CAMERAS tree; the live picture fills the right.
• Snapshot saves the picture you're watching to your Desktop.
• Full Screen (button or double-click the picture) blows the live view up to fill the window; Esc or double-click again to come back.
